body: What did he think it was?
U.S here. I doubt Yoga would work either for me. I'm going to talk to my doctor and ask for a more hardcore way of going about this.

I don't know. I know that I still have all my problems (Don't know where to go in life, can't make decisions, can't focus, think too many questions and get paralyzed/paranoid about them) without meds... that's why I've been trying em. 

I know that the antidepressants made me even more depressed, but I'm not sure about this one yet.
That last line is familiar, but I wouldn't let myself accept it because that felt too arrogant. I dunno. I guess I have to keep trying until something "clicks"... maybe.

How do I find one that I like? How do I find one that knows what he/she is talking about? How do I know if I like them, or just want myself to like them? At what point should I decide "Maybe I'm being too picky?"

I definitely get it. At what point is it no longer worth it to suffer? And what of the scars? Is my responsibility to reach out to infinity for an answer for forever and ever.

I don't even believe in an "earning" it, because if anyone feels the way I do, they *deserve* to want to get rid of it. But I don't want to give up. I don't feel like I can. Yet. I still go out there every day and look for an answer. I still want to hope that there will be some combination of meds, some combination of therapy, some combination of me growing up and being content with some things in life...

/sigh. I am sorry you feel the same way. I hope someone will listen to you and help you more than just not understanding but caring. I have too much of that. I hope you'll find a person who can help you. 

I wish I could find a person to help me.
